notes:
New in 1.2.0:
• Text editor: edit text and code files right in the viewer, with code colouring, undo/redo, pinch zoom and a symbol key row.
• Screen rotation setting (Settings › Appearance): Auto, Portrait or Landscape.
• Cloud/network remotes (including Samba/SMB) can be opened like normal folders and picked from the drive menu; copies run in the background with retry.
• "Open in BFE as": open any file as Text, Hex editor, Archive, Image, Music, Video, Web, Document, Font, SVG, APK or Run script.
• APK internals: view and edit an app's manifest/binary XML, resources and dex (smali) code, browse Java classes and jars, then save to a new APK or over the original (re-signed).
• Fixes: phones with 1 TB storage no longer show 2 TB; cloud files no longer show a fake year-2000 date.
